FILED s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 13:27).  Source: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/ultra-s513g-findings.md (the cloud review's four findings, 1 and 2 probed live by the clone session: `PCL_NO_PROTO_CACHE=1 PCL_PROTO_ORACLE=DIR ./pl2cl prog.pl` with `use Text::Wrap` leaves Text_Wrap.json holding only the overlay's names; `./pl2cl Pl/t/lib/FactsConflict.pm` exits 0 where the doc says it dies).  None changes product behaviour (the batch is merged as ddd8e383); all four are in Pl/Parser.pm's overlay block (+212 lines, s513g).  The fix is one filler commit on a worktree: (1) one line in _facts_overlay_env or the dump site; (2) either register the own-sub conflict where the pre-scan registers named subs (then the unit path dies like the use path -- the stronger choice, matching the doc) or delete the dead branch and narrow docs/shipped-modules.md + the comment to the use path -- EITHER WAY a guard row in Pl/t/facts-overlay-01.t that transpiles Pl/t/lib/FactsConflict.pm as a UNIT and asserts the die (row 6 covers only `use`); (3) + (4) while there.  Bars: the targeted gate (facts-overlay-01.t + proto-cache / script-cache files), corpus-diff IDENTICAL (no emission change expected), no generation bump unless the emission moves.  Do NOT apply in the ultra-s513g clone (no remote; the batch is merged).

=== DONE (s514b) === commit 59071067.  (1) _facts_overlay_env walks the overlay as PCL::Facts::<Module>, so the proto-oracle dump is PCL_Facts_Text_Wrap.json and Text_Wrap.json keeps wrap/fill (probed).  (2) MOVED, the stronger choice: register_unit_overlay tags its records from_overlay + overlay_unit, and Pl::Environment::add_prototype asks the conflict rule when the unit's OWN (non-imported) declaration replaces one; `pl2cl Pl/t/lib/FactsConflict.pm` now dies naming both files, as docs/shipped-modules.md said (doc sentence extended).  (3) ONE helper Pl::Environment::overlay_conflict_check for both paths; _facts_proto_text deleted.  (4) overlay records copied through _imported_record (both tables).  The six shipped overlays' real module units still transpile (rc 0).  Guard: facts-overlay-01.t row 7 (fails on 134ca17f).
